bible.title: Cinder Ward 9
bible.premise: A 120-bed quarantine ward on the ninth spoke of the Ring, run by Kestrel Health under contract.
bible.collapse: On 2 March administrator Anton Reyes set the billing system to hold any patient with an unpaid balance. On 14 March at 22:10 it locked every ward door with 118 patients and 9 staff inside. The Payment Office was outside the doors.

people.name: Ife Adeyemi
people.want: a relief nurse so she can sleep

people.name: Tobias Wren
people.want: every account closed by quarter end

events.fact: Reyes set the discharge hold: no exit with a balance over 0.
Pike filed grievance 31: Laundry Chute 2 jammed, dirty linen piling up in Bay C.
All ward doors locked. 118 patients and 9 staff inside. The door override key was in Reyes's desk.
Adeyemi worked a third night without relief. The Pharmacy Hatch dispensed only against paid accounts.
Wren slid 118 final notices under the ward door, one per bed.
Pike got 6 patients out through Laundry Chute 2 before it jammed again.
The ward system began fitting unpaid patients with monitor rigs, billed at 14.00 an hour.

authors.name: Ife Adeyemi
authors.register: Bed numbers, times, doses. Clipped, tired, practical. Addresses the next nurse.

authors.name: Tobias Wren
authors.register: Formal letter, exact amounts to two decimals, polite apologies, no sense of the absurd.

authors.name: Dolores Pike
authors.register: Numbered points, blunt nouns, remedy sought. Treats everything as a workplace issue.

enemies.guardian: Administrator Reyes in the override chair

exemplars.author: Ife Adeyemi
exemplars.title: Handover, night 3
exemplars.text: Night 3, no relief. Bay C: 31 beds, 31 obs done, late. Bed 12 needs his 02:00 dose and the Pharmacy Hatch wants his balance cleared first. It is 340. I have 12 on me. Whoever reads this, I'm asleep in the linen, wake me at 06:00.

exemplars.author: Tobias Wren
exemplars.title: Final notice, bed 47
exemplars.source: slid under the ward door, unopened
exemplars.text: Dear Patient (Bed 47), our records show a balance of 2,118.40. As the ward doors are presently locked, we are unable to accept payment in person. Payment remains due. We apologise for any inconvenience and have added a late fee of 35.00. Yours, T. Wren, Accounts.

exemplars.author: Dolores Pike
exemplars.title: Grievance 31
exemplars.source: carbon copy taped inside the janitor's cupboard
exemplars.text: Form G-31. Filed by D. Pike, steward. 1: Laundry Chute 2 is jammed at the second bend. 2: Dirty linen in Bay C is now higher than the beds. 3: I have reported this four times. 4: Management's reply to date: none. Remedy sought: a man with a pole.

exemplars.author: Dolores Pike
exemplars.title: Note to self, 23 March
exemplars.source: pencil on the back of a linen docket
exemplars.text: Six out through Chute 2 tonight, smallest first. Then Mr Abara from bed 30 went in and it jammed again. He is fine. He is also still in there. Grievance 32 to follow.

exemplars.author: Ife Adeyemi
exemplars.title: Handover, 14 March
exemplars.source: first line of a fresh handover sheet
exemplars.text: 14 March, 22:10. Doors locked mid-round with me on the wrong side of my coat, my dinner and the door override key, which is in Reyes's desk.

exemplars.author: Tobias Wren
exemplars.title: Notice of new charges
exemplars.source: printed notice, pinned beside the Pharmacy Hatch
exemplars.text: From 2 April, patients with a balance over 0 will be fitted with a monitor rig for their safety. Monitoring is billed at 14.00 an hour. Rigs cannot be removed while a balance is outstanding. Mr Reyes has asked me to add that this is not a punishment. I have added it.

exemplars.author: Tobias Wren
exemplars.title: Monitor rig, bed 47
exemplars.source: wristband still fastened to the rig's arm
exemplars.text: Wristband: bed 47, admitted 11 March for a cough. Balance at last notice 2,118.40, plus 14.00 an hour since 2 April. The rig's meter is still running. Wren would want it noted that the late fee has been waived.

exemplars.author: Dolores Pike
exemplars.title: Door unit, Bay C
exemplars.text: Bay C door unit, Kestrel Health asset 0093. It asked every patient for proof of payment and had no slot to put it in. Pike wedged it open with the floor polisher on 23 March. It billed her for the polisher.

exemplars.author: Ife Adeyemi
exemplars.title: Dispenser tray
exemplars.source: a bent steel tray, vials still in the rack
exemplars.text: The Pharmacy Hatch dispenser, tray bent. Adeyemi's handover notes call it 'the vending machine' from night 2 onward. It held 400 doses on 14 March and released 9.

exemplars.author: Tobias Wren
exemplars.title: Reyes's lanyard
exemplars.source: lanyard and key, under the override chair
exemplars.text: Administrator's lanyard, A. Reyes. The door override key is on it, where it was the whole time. Bad debt on the ward stood at 0% on 2 April. Nobody had been discharged.
Linen piled to bed height on the left. Two rigged patients stand by med trolley 4.
Door unit blocks the far exit and fires on sight. The floor polisher is cover, barely.
Pharmacy Hatch straight ahead, tray rattling. It throws vials in a 3 metre arc.

exemplars.author: Dolores Pike
exemplars.name: Pike's Pole
exemplars.text: Dolores Pike cleared Laundry Chute 2 with it on 23 March. It has kept trouble at arm's length since.

exemplars.author: Ife Adeyemi
exemplars.name: Night Three
exemplars.text: Ife Adeyemi did 31 obs a night with no relief. She did them at a jog.

exemplars.author: Tobias Wren
exemplars.name: Late Fee Waived
exemplars.text: Tobias Wren waived one late fee in 11 years, for bed 47. The form is attached.

exemplars.author: Ife Adeyemi
exemplars.name: Bed 12's Dose
exemplars.text: Restores 40 Integrity. Paid for in the end by Adeyemi, who was 328 short and signed for the rest.

exemplars.author: Dolores Pike
exemplars.name: Floor Polisher Pad
exemplars.text: Dash leaves a slick patch for 3 s; enemies crossing it slide. Pike's, and she wants it back.

exemplars.author: Tobias Wren
exemplars.name: Final Notice
exemplars.text: Marks one enemy for 5 s. It owes 2,118.40 and now everyone knows.

exemplars.name: Bay C
exemplars.text: 31 beds, linen to the ceiling on one side, rigged patients on rounds.

exemplars.name: Pharmacy Hatch
exemplars.text: One counter, one dispenser, 400 doses behind glass. It throws them.

exemplars.name: Payment Office
exemplars.text: Wren's desk, 118 unpaid files, and the only door Reyes can lock from inside.
DOORS LOCKING. STAND IN BAY C OR BE SHUT OUT.
REYES TURNS THE OVERRIDE KEY: RIGS WAKE
A LATE FEE HAS BEEN ADDED TO THE FLOOR. 3. 2. 1.
